description: Read the site's collection field definitions (`_data/collections.json`, draft view): { schema: { v: 1, collections: { "<key>": { fields[], settings? } } }, hash }. hash is null when no schema exists yet — pass it as put_collection_schema ifMatch. 409 collection_schema_invalid { hash, issues } means the stored file is broken: fix it with put_collection_schema using that hash.
name: get_collection_schema
